title: Wouldn't recommend this cheap crap
text: Wouldn't recommend this cheap crap. Fell apart the first time I put it in the washer. I thought maybe I might not have put it together right so I tried it again with the same results. Falls apart in the washing machine. Plastic is very cheap and has stress marks. Wouldn't recommend this cheap crap.
